airtoxscreen_cautions: Not an annual incidence rate or number of observed cases.
Totals rounded by EPA to one significant figure; components retain numerical model precision, not scientific precision.
Does not quantify diesel particulate cancer risk; diesel-related other pollutants may contribute.
Does not include every workplace exposure, indoor source, radon or contaminant pathway.
Secondary chemistry is not a simple facility or industry attribution.
2020 conditions, including pandemic effects; not proof of current conditions.
transformations: All 1695 TRI forms retained in original; groupings sum reported numeric Form R quantities, with Form A counted separately as unquantified.
Pounds and grams always kept separate; absent numeric Form R records in a unit yield blank summary quantities, not inferred zero releases.
OSHA carcinogen flag is the source category; it is not a uniform potency or IARC Group 1 classification.
Iowa rows extracted from national AirToxScreen workbooks; all 99 counties retained; source columns preserved.
Four facilities report more than one primary NAICS across chemical forms; all values retained as semicolon lists in facility summary.
No release-risk or release-cancer correlations calculated.
